name: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (AI Provisions)

use_case_categories: Healthcare AI systems processing protected health information
scope.description: Applies to covered entities and business associates using AI systems that create, receive, maintain, or transmit PHI.

requirements.obligation: Conduct risk analysis of AI systems processing PHI
requirements.penalty: Up to $2.1M per violation category per year

requirements.obligation: Implement access controls for AI endpoints processing PHI
requirements.penalty: Up to $2.1M per violation category per year

requirements.obligation: Implement audit controls recording AI system activity involving PHI
requirements.penalty: Up to $2.1M per violation category per year

requirements.obligation: Implement transmission security for PHI sent to AI processing endpoints
requirements.penalty: Up to $2.1M per violation category per year

requirements.obligation: Train workforce on AI system PHI handling procedures
requirements.penalty: Up to $2.1M per violation category per year

requirements.obligation: Notify affected individuals and HHS of AI-related PHI breaches
requirements.penalty: Up to $2.1M per violation category per year

ai_risk_tier: Maps to GAIF Critical for all AI systems processing PHI

compliance_routing_rules: Route PHI-containing queries only to HIPAA-compliant endpoints
Require BAA for all Tier B vendor AI services processing PHI
behavioral_contract_thresholds: Safety field: PHI exposure rate = 0% (zero tolerance)
Conf field: 99.9% confidence on PHI routing decisions
disclosure_requirements: Minimum necessary standard applied to AI query construction
monitoring_requirements: Continuous monitoring of PHI exposure in AI query/response logs
Audit trail retention per HIPAA requirements
